realizes.rationale: Branches ordinary document-chat presentation from review explainer presentation: an unbound pending review keeps the frame under its task-list hold, a known-missing review hides it behind the problem, and a bound leaf review uses the explainer column’s showFrame and frameTarget. The ordinary branch preserves docState hide/wait behavior; DocumentChatImpl keeps the single wrapper mounted across both branches.
The frame wrapper carries the agentless-hidden state, so it must remove the frame from reach exactly when no agent is shown.
Mounts the column dock right after the frame's wrapper, outside the iframe.
Separates ordinary launcher/wait presentation from the leaf review’s explainer placeholder and isolates pending/missing task holds before any selected agent can be targeted.
Publishes the active, nonhidden bound document-chat target; this publication does not wait for a native drawn acknowledgement.
The ordinary and explainer chrome share this one persistent frame wrapper and sibling dock across page and phase changes.
Selects the ordinary or explainer state owner and composes its chrome over one retained native frame; the explainer branch disables ordinary document discovery.
The persistent TrayColumnDock stays immediately after and outside the shared native frame wrapper while document and explainer modes switch.

7.note:
Compose ordinary document-chat chrome or the review leaf's explainer chrome above one persistent native frame and one tray dock. Ordinary documents retain their bound launcher, warmup and held-frame behavior. An explainer target disables ordinary document discovery and uses useExplainerColumn instead: resolveDocumentFrameProps supplies the explainer's frame target and showFrame state, while ColumnChrome displays its placeholder, form, progress or header. Pending unbound review identity retains the screen under its wait line; known missing identity displays the named problem. The frame wrapper remains keyed persistent-chat-frame across modes and the sibling TrayColumnDock remains persistent-tray-dock. Ordinary visible targets publish via documentShownChat; explainer targets publish through columnState, including a placeholder identity when no seat exists.
